subject: Re: MAP — context depth & pricing clarification for BrightCart pilot
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thomas <claire@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: MAP — context depth & pricing clarification for BrightCart pilot

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the asks we promised to send over so procurement and engineering can align on sizing/pricing for the pilot. I tried to be concise; please flag anything off.

Summary of what you told us:
- Pilot scope: answer-generation + product QA assistant for seller support (web UI + Slack).
- Expected traffic: 400–800 active users during pilot; estimate ~250k–600k API calls / month per environment.
- Output behavior: most queries are short prompts (search-like) but a subset are longer (product-context + logs) that may hit larger windows.
- SLA: sub-300ms token latency target on core flows, ability to burst during Black Friday test window.

Key sizing we captured (ask: confirm the percentages below):
- Average prompt tokens: 90–140 (we used 120 as a working avg).
- Average completion tokens: 260–520 (working avg 400).
- Combined avg tokens per request: ~520 (120 prompt + 400 completion).
- Expected token mix by window need: ~78% 8k, 20% 32k, 2% 128k (these are our notes from call; please adjust).

Cost / unit-econ framing (to help procurement):
- With your expected mix and a 720M tokens/month run-rate (example: 1.38M requests * 520 avg tokens) the ballpark usage is ~720M tokens / mo.
- Target unit ask you mentioned in call: ~$1,200 per 1M tokens (open to negotiation if commit changes).
- Example monthly spend at that target: $864k / mo.

What we need from BrightCart to finalize an accurate commercial:
1) Confirm the % split you expect across 8k / 32k / 128k windows (we wrote 78 / 20 / 2).
2) Agree on a representative prompt/completion sample (we attached a token profile worksheet) — ideally 200 sample queries with token counts.
3) Confirm expected peak RPS during the Black Friday test (burst sizing for Dedicated pool).
4) Procurement: preferred contract term (3, 6, 12 months) and target commit tier.

Attachments: BrightCart_token_profile.xlsx (token-by-query samples), MAP_BrightCart_v1.pdf (mutual action plan draft).

Next steps: if you confirm (1) and (2) by Friday EOD we can generate a model-specific cost sheet + recommended Dedicated sizing and a pilot pricing proposal by Monday.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]

From: Claire Thomas <claire@brightcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP — context depth & pricing clarification for BrightCart pilot

Thanks, Jordan — great summary and appreciated the format. Quick clarifications from our side:

1) Token/window mix — updated based on our backend traces: 82% 8k, 16% 32k, 2% 128k (we see more short queries than we initially said).
2) Sample set — I'll export 250 anonymized queries with token counts (removing any PII) and drop in the Drive folder by Thursday morning.
3) Black Friday burst — planning for a short 45-minute spike at ~220 RPS sustained across the web UI (worst-case), but average daily peak is currently ~35 RPS.
4) Contract term — procurement prefers a 6-month pilot with a one-time trial credit and a committed tier option if we meet >500k requests / month.

On pricing: the $1,200 / 1M tokens is higher than procurement expected. Their target is closer to $750–900 / 1M for a mid-sized pilot. Is there a way to map savings if we commit to a minimum spend or sign up for Dedicated? Would you share a quick delta table (hosted vs dedicated vs caching benefits) so we can evaluate?

Claire
Claire Thomas
Head of Product, BrightCart
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 13:28:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP — context depth & pricing clarification for BrightCart pilot

Passing along BrightCart's updated mix and procurement target. Quick internal notes / pricing approach ideas:

- If BrightCart moves commits to Dedicated with a 6-month term we can target $900 / 1M as a baseline with caching/batch config guidance to lower effective spend toward $700 / 1M.
- Host (pay-as-you-go) list is $1,350 / 1M at the performance tier they want (sub-300ms); dedicated reserved pool discounts apply at commit tiers.
- Key levers to present in the delta table: batching, KV/prefix caching, quantized model variant for background tasks, and window-aware routing (route 128k flows to cheaper spot capacity).

I sketched a simple delta we can put in the proposal:
- Baseline (hosted, no caching): $1,350 / 1M -> est $972k / mo at 720M tokens
- Dedicated (6m commit, guidance applied): $900 / 1M -> est $648k / mo
- Dedicated + caching/batch improvements (engineering onboarding): $700 / 1M -> est $504k / mo

We should include the RPS burst buffer pricing and a recommended Dedicated pool size (N GPUs) with an explicit Black Friday spike plan. Jordan — I can draft the delta table and recommended pilot SLAs if you want me to own it.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Pricing, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Thomas <claire@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP — context depth & pricing clarification for BrightCart pilot

Claire — thanks for the quick turnaround and the concrete numbers. Two quick commitments from our side:

1) We'll send a short cost-delta one-pager (hosted vs dedicated vs optimized) by EOD Thursday. It will include: expected $/1M tokens for each tier, the assumptions on token mix (82/16/2), and the engineering effort to reach the $700 / 1M sweet spot.
2) If you confirm the 250-sample token export I can run the exact token-weighted costing and provide a model-specific pilot quote (with a Dedicated sizing recommendation) by Monday morning.

Action items:
- Claire: drop the anonymized sample set in Drive (THU morning).
- Procurement: confirm target commit (we'll show 3/6/12m options; highlight 6m as BrightCart preference).
- Marissa: please draft the cost-delta one-pager and include a short runbook for the Black Friday 45-minute 220 RPS spike.

I'll also add a line in the MAP doc (attached) to reflect the pricing cadence.

Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
